description:
Found by the fz-kdt.152 build (2026-09-02). PRE-EXISTING and NOT mailbox-related: identical at 62b5b09fe and after fz-kdt.152's fix, and identical with a STATIC lambda, so neither the mailbox nor the callable layout is involved.

  fn main() do
    dbg(Enum.reduce([1, 2, 3], {0, 0}, fn (x, acc) -> {elem(acc, 0) + x, elem(acc, 1) + 1} end))
  end

All three doors: error[lower/unbound] -- 'compiler2 lowering found unresolved
direct runtime ...'. Elixir answers {6, 3}.

An int accumulator and a LIST accumulator both work on all three doors
(pinned in fixtures2/behavior/mailbox_closure_reduce.fz), so it is the TUPLE
accumulator that breaks: the tuple threaded through List.reduce_cont/3's
{:cont, acc} / {:done, acc} carrier meeting elem/2 on the way back out.
Likely the same family as the tuple-position readings in fz-kdt.138.
title: Enum.reduce with a tuple accumulator compiles on no path -- lower/unbound
